name: RL-4
description: RL-4 was a Protocol droid used by the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War as a special envoy in Office of the Supreme Chancellor Leontyne Saresh. In 3639 BBY RL-4 was visiting the Carrick Station, where he contacted an important figure, specifically selected by the Supreme Chancellor, to join Captain Hardin of the Outrider on a mission to the Vyron system.
